drafts.subject: Invoice INV-004417 (PO 4500012148) - already received, no action needed
drafts.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your invoice INV-004417 dated 14 August 2026 for $5,420.80 (including GST), raised against our purchase order 4500012148.

We received a second copy of this invoice. Our records show the original was already entered into our system on 18 August 2026, so the resent copy will not be processed and the invoice will not be paid twice. It is scheduled for payment on 30 September 2026 in line with the agreed terms.

No action is needed from you, and there is no need to resend the invoice.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
